private.heading: Private Offices
private.pageDescription: Let a whole office to a company at a flat price — one booking, one company.
private.noPermission: Ask a space owner or admin to manage private offices.
private.emptyDesc: Create an office, then let it to a company on a monthly or fixed-term agreement.
private.noTenant: No tenant yet — ready to assign.
private.publicOccupiedHint: Shown publicly as occupied — visitors can register interest for when it frees up.
private.publicUnlistedHint: List it to show as occupied on your public page and capture interest for when it frees up.

form.desc: A whole office let to one company at a flat monthly price.
form.name: Name
form.autoInvoiceDesc: When this office is let on an open-ended agreement, create the next monthly invoice automatically.

assign.title: Assign {{name}}
assign.desc: Let this office to a company on a monthly agreement.
assign.companyHint: Pick an existing member or type a new company — added to Members if new.
assign.termHint: Leave the end date empty for an open-ended (ongoing) contract; set it for a fixed term (e.g. a couple of weeks).
assign.flatPriceHint: Flat price for the whole period.
assign.monthlyPriceHint: Billed each month while the office is occupied.
assign.notesPlaceholder: Agreement terms, contacts, anything to remember…
assign.datesErrorDesc: End date is before the start date.

endAgreement.title: End agreement with {{company}}?
endAgreement.desc: The office becomes vacant. The agreement is kept as ended for your records.

delete.title: Delete this office?
delete.descOccupied: This office is currently occupied — its active agreement will be ended too. This removes the office from the list.
delete.descVacant: This removes the office from the list. Past agreements are kept for your records.

virtual.heading: Virtual Offices
virtual.pageDescription: Members who buy a business address and mail handling — billed monthly, with no desk taken up.
virtual.noPermission: Ask a space owner or admin to manage virtual offices.
virtual.planOffDesc: Turn on the Virtual Office plan to start tracking address-only members and their revenue.
virtual.emptyActiveDesc: Activate the plan for a member to bill them for a business address — no desk taken up.

endDialog.title: End virtual office for {{name}}?
endDialog.desc: They stop counting toward revenue from today and move to the Past tab. Their member record and any invoices stay intact — you can re-activate later.
endDialog.successDesc: {{name}} is no longer on the plan.

addDialog.title: Add virtual office member
addDialog.desc: Bill a member for a business address — they take up no desk.
addDialog.memberHint: Pick an existing member or type a new one — added to Members if new.
addDialog.ongoingHint: Like an ongoing dedicated desk, this membership stays active until you end it.
addDialog.priceHint: Defaults to the plan price; change it for a per-member rate.
addDialog.endDateRequiredDesc: Set an end date or choose ongoing.
addDialog.datesErrorDesc: End date is before the start date.

renewDialog.title: {{verb}} {{name}}
renewDialog.descRenew: Restart the virtual office period with a new end date. The start date stays the same.
renewDialog.descEdit: Edit the dates, end date, monthly price and notes for this member.
renewDialog.endDateRequiredDesc: Set an end date or choose open-ended.
renewDialog.dateInPastDesc: The end date cannot be in the past.
renewDialog.nextBillingHint: The first service date OhMyDesk will invoice next.
renewDialog.nextBillingUnavailable: No recurring billing is scheduled for this virtual office.
renewDialog.notesPlaceholder: Internal notes about this virtual office
